name: Destruction in Deadmines
summary: Deep beneath Moonbrook, Defias industry is poisoning the land. Alba Fairmoon suspects their metallurgical forge is the source of the blight and sends you to destroy it with explosives.

sections.title: Sabotaging the Foundry
sections.body: Beneath Moonbrook, the Deadmines shelter a fortified complex that powers the Defias Brotherhood. Its heavy forge smelts metal and builds machinery. Alba Fairmoon believes this forge is the likely origin of the contamination blighting the area. Destroying it is her aim.

sections.title: A Decisive Blast
sections.body: The forge lies beyond barricades, cutthroats, and goblin engineers. You carry Extra-Destructive Explosives and plant them beside the forge works. Then you escape to the hills above Moonbrook, where Alba Fairmoon waits to detonate the charge and hopes the land can begin to heal.

faq.q: What is the goal of this mission?
faq.answer: You are to enter the Deadmines beneath Moonbrook, find the Defias Brotherhood's metallurgical forge, and plant Extra-Destructive Explosives nearby. Alba Fairmoon waits at the exit.
Alba Fairmoon is an Alliance operative in Westfall. She believes the blight and poison in the region come from heavy smelting and industrial work inside the Deadmines.

faq.q: Why is the Defias forge considered so dangerous?
faq.answer: Alba suspects the large metallurgical forge in the Deadmines is the source of the poison. She hopes destroying it will let the land begin to heal.

faq.q: Where does the player meet Alba after planting the explosives?
faq.answer: Alba Fairmoon waits in the hills behind Moonbrook, outside the Deadmines near the mine's upper exit. She is ready to trigger the explosives once you emerge safely.

faq.q: Where is the forge located inside the Deadmines?
faq.answer: The forge lies deep inside the Deadmines, past the mining tunnels in the industrial foundry, where Defias laborers and goblin overseers work.

faq.q: Does destroying the forge heal the land immediately?
faq.answer: Alba hopes ending the heavy smelting will let the land around Moonbrook recover. Years of Defias industry and neglect will take time to wash away.

angles.text: Alba Fairmoon proposes using specialized Extra-Destructive Explosives against heavy industrial works to remove the suspected source of contamination.
The Deadmines were once Stormwind's richest gold and iron mines. The Defias have turned them into a fortified smelting complex that blights the earth.
Destroying the Defias forge strikes at the machinery and weapons threatening Stormwind's sovereignty from within Westfall.
